<function name="OnActivePanelChanged" parent="DPanelSelect" type="panelhook">
	<description>Called when the selected panel changes.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="oldPnl" type="Panel">Old selected panel.</arg>
		<arg name="newPnl" type="Panel">New selected panel.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
